item.title: The AI Strategy Brief — Episode 3: Measure Growth, Not Hours
item.description:
Wharton x GBK, n=1,416: growth-measuring departments report strongly positive AI returns at 35% vs 13% for efficiency-only; a designated Chief AI Officer tracks with 58% vs 8% with no such role. Plus Oyster's invisible AI workforce (95% doing AI work their job descriptions never mention) and the WSJ orchestration gap (183 tools on average, only 15% unified). AI-generated and human-reviewed for correctness.
Chapters: (00:00) Measure growth, not hours (01:20) Growth vs efficiency: 35 vs 13 (02:36) Ownership and one platform (03:41) Workflows and the supervised middle (05:01) The invisible AI workforce (06:43) Tool sprawl and the Monday action
